verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Copilot can review code and give feedback that includes suggested changes you can apply with a couple of clicks (github-docs-25). Copilot can also be assigned initial reviews on pull requests (github-docs-9) and reviews your changes as a core feature (github-docs-56). Copilot Autofix adds fix suggestions on the security side (github-docs-5). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality, and deeper documentation of how reviews analyze diffs (e.g., customization, scope of analysis).
